svg.title: Mesh-Sim system overview
svg.desc: Scenario files and Python tools feed the simulator; the simulator runs setup once, then evaluates links, generates traffic, routes flows and writes outputs every tick; the run outputs are read by the visualizer.
svg.text: Simulator · sim.cc, C++ modules in src/
run.ini + JSON files into a SimConfig;
optional RL step: rl/ ⇄ Python env over stdin/stdout JSON
seed-N/ positions, links, rx-power, mcs, flows, routes CSVs
